title: Hire Your Anthropologist! Rethinking Culture Benchmarks Through an Anthropological Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of 20 cultural NLP benchmarks through a four-part anthropological taxonomy (knowledge, preference, dynamics, bias) to identify methodological flaws such as flattening cultural complexity, conflating culture with nation-states, and assuming cultural consensus.

Review of 'Culture-as-Bias' benchmarks (e.g., BBQ, Crows-Pairs, BOLD) that measure how language models reflect and reinforce stereotypes related to race, gender, and class through question answering, minimal pairs, and open-ended generation.

Analysis of benchmark data sourcing methodologies (e.g., drawing from Reddit or Wikipedia) to highlight demographic skews that privilege Western, urban, and digitally literate users over diverse, global, or marginalized perspectives.
